text: [issue by xg787] ### Describe the bug Invisible facade items ### How to reproduce the bug idk it just happens after a certain point when adding mods :/ ### Expected behavior facade items rendering properly ### Additional details this issue is also present on 1.20.1 forge facades render fine when placed on a cable ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen?
